**Honest memory note:** the RSS column is the process-level high-water mark (`getrusage(ru_maxrss)`) — monotonic across stages, so per-stage deltas under-report for stages allocating less than an earlier peak. The final row is the true total peak.

**Scaling limits (stated honestly):** ingest/audit/clean run on Polars with streaming collects and sampled approximations (correlations, duplicate scan) and handle data beyond RAM for *text ingest*; the fitted sklearn stage (impute/select/scale) is in-memory — datasets must fit in RAM *after* the string→numeric snapshot conversion. Sampling parameters live in the config (`audit.*`, `preprocessing.selection.sample_size`).
